title: Foundation Established
description: NS Engineering & Geotechnical Services begins operations with a commitment to quality, integrity, and scientific excellence in Nepal's geotechnical sector.

title: Advanced Equipment
description: Invested in state-of-the-art drilling and testing equipment. Achieved capacity for rotary drilling up to 700m depth.

title: Major Projects
description: Secured contracts for major infrastructure projects including roads, bridges, and hydropower facilities across Nepal.

title: ISO 9001:2015 Certification
description: Achieved ISO 9001:2015 certification, demonstrating commitment to quality management systems and customer satisfaction.

title: Geophysical Services Launch
description: Expanded service portfolio to include MASW, ERT, and seismic refraction surveys. Strengthened capabilities in geophysical investigations.

title: Laboratory Enhancement
description: Upgraded laboratory facility in Lalitpur with cutting-edge testing equipment for soil, rock, and materials analysis.

title: Pile Testing Excellence
description: Introduced advanced pile testing services including PDA, PIT, and cross-hole sonic logging with international standard equipment.

title: International Collaboration
description: Worked with consulting firms from China, Japan, Germany, UK, France, Canada, and 10+ other countries on complex projects.

title: Continuous Innovation
description: Ongoing investment in technology, training, and methodologies. Committed to staying at the forefront of geotechnical engineering.
